sourceTitle: Milton Keynes Foster Carer Payments Scheme 2026/27 (Milton Keynes City Council)
feesNote: Milton Keynes pays a weekly professional fee for each child in placement, by the carer's tier; new carers start at Tier 1.
extras: A birthday allowance for a gift each year, with at least £83 to be spent
A yearly festival payment that rises with the child's age, from £83 for under-fives to £207 for 16 to 18 year olds
A holiday allowance of up to £517 per child a year towards a family holiday, on request
summary: Milton Keynes' 2026/27 scheme, which applies from 6 April 2026, pays a weekly maintenance allowance by the child's age that covers day-to-day costs, clothing, pocket money and savings. On top of this, carers receive a weekly professional fee for each child, set by their tier.
